cutscenes.title: A Locked Cache
cutscenes.text: The chest seal breaks. Someone passed here before you, and they were in a hurry.

cutscenes.title: Steel Memory
cutscenes.text: Your stance stops shaking. The dungeon no longer feels bigger than you.

cutscenes.title: Signal in the Dark
cutscenes.text: A weak stream signal catches. The audience count moves from zero to one.

cutscenes.title: Hands Like Smoke
cutscenes.text: You map weight and motion in a blink. Theft feels less like chance and more like geometry.

cutscenes.title: Chapter Closed
cutscenes.text: Another level is behind you. The dungeon's story has one less page to write.

cutscenes.title: Surface Air
cutscenes.text: The final gate opens. Kael steps out carrying twelve chapters of proof.
